desc: A close-up of Oscar talking into the camera, as Dwight and Phyllis approach curiously behind him.
A close-up of Oscar, with Kelly behind him applying makeup and staring at the camera.
Kevin and another man bump heads, both holding their faces in pain, as Dwight and Phyllis watch.
A man and a young girl excitedly wave their hands in front of a blue backdrop for a photo shoot.
Stanley smiles with his arm around a young woman for a photo, standing in front of a blue backdrop with giant toy blocks nearby.
Creed poses for a photo with two elderly people beside him as a woman photographs them in front of a blue backdrop.
Meredith stands beside a young man with face tattoos and crossed arms for the photo.
Jim tears off Dwight's clothes at the parking lot.
Darryl, at his office desk, drinks from a pink can with a disgusted expression.
Andy walks into the office wearing gray coveralls, looking down with a defeated expression.
Andy, wearing gray coveralls, gets down on his knees in front of a woman sitting at the desk.
Andy, in gray coveralls, mops a carpet on the office floor, as coworkers sit at their desks nearby.
Pam, with the stroller and a kid holding her hand, enters the office, Jim surprised and fake-smiling.
A woman with a stuffed duck takes photos of Jim and Pam with the kids, as Dwight jumps behind her.
Dwight pulls a comb out of his jacket pocket and walks up to Angela, who is taking a photo with a man and a child.
Andy, in the bathroom, pours alcohol on himself from a bottle, standing in front of the mirror and sink.
Andy, in coveralls, carries a bowl of soup and then pours it over himself.
Andy eats the soup he poured on himself off his sleeve.
Dwight with small scissors walks up to Angela, who is taking a photo with a man and a child.
Dwight is leaving the office with a  clear plastic bag as Angela chases him, seen through the kitchen door blinds.
A red car leaves the office parking lot in a rush, when blue car starts chasing it.
Dwight, driving in the car, waves a clear plastic bag with a smile, while another car is visible in the rear window.
A tall man in a birthday hat, holding a cupcake with a candle, walks into a room with people at a table.
A red car speeds down a country road, a blue car right behind it.
Kelly poses for a photo with a man, hugging him against a blue photo backdrop.
Two red cars drive through a quiet suburban street lined with houses and trees, a blue car chasing the other one by mistake.
Andy stands near the reception desk taking off his coveralls, revealing a suit underneath, as coworkers watch.
A blue car cuts off the red one, and Angela runs out of the blue car.
Angela slaps her hand on the window and opens the driver's door of the red car, who then gets out.
Angela slaps the man from the red car, who later runs away.
A shot of a man taking down the 'Sabre' sign next to the Dunder Mifflin logo on the wall.
The man in glasses hugs and then kisses Andy on the lips near the reception desk.
Angela puts her hand on Dwight's hand as they sit together in a waiting room.
Dwight tries to kiss Angela, who pushes him away, then kisses him hard, as they sit together in a waiting room.
